turns.assessment: The interruption of svc277 aligns with its working-to-protection switch at t=677.4 s. Immediately afterward, trx.och158.a at S08 raised EQPT_TX_FAIL and the far-end receiver at S21 lost och158; svc260, which also uses och158, switched at the same instant. Unchanged amplifier telemetry and unaffected neighboring channels argue strongly against an OMS, span, or amplifier failure, while the earlier och85 card failure explains the separate degraded services and is unrelated to svc277.

proposals.rationale: The S08 line interface explicitly reported transmitter failure, followed by loss of signal at its far-end receiver at S21 and simultaneous SNCP switching of both services carried over och158.
A broader line-interface card failure could also remove the transmitted channel, but there is no CARD_FAIL alarm or evidence that the local receive side and monitoring became unavailable.
